Socratic AI Tutor

Use AI as a learning assistant that asks, probes and challenges reasoning before simply giving the answer.

Supported scope
Teacher objectives, grounding text and text support files
Design focus
Question before answer
Built as a Moodle plugin first: permissions, native APIs and human review remain part of the workflow instead of being replaced by an external black box.
Practical results
Production-minded
✓
Grounded tutor behavior
Teachers define the learning objective, reference content and additional tutor behavior.
✓
Reliable conversation state
Persist learner turns before the AI call and use idempotency plus Moodle locks to prevent duplicate submissions.
✓
Configurable completion
Complete after interactions, conversation end, teacher marking or Moodle manual completion.
Bounded context
Only a configurable recent history and capped grounding context are sent to AI.
Text-only support files
Accept deterministic UTF-8 formats and reject PDF/DOCX rather than pretending their contents were understood.
No subjective AI grade
The activity does not automatically grade learners from model judgement.
What this plugin does

Socratic AI Tutor is intentionally not a generic chat box. Its system behavior asks learners to justify ideas, examine counterexamples and reflect, while staying inside teacher-provided objectives and reference material.

The activity is built for failures and retries: a learner message is stored first, duplicate browser submissions share an idempotency token, and a pending turn can be retried after reload without creating a second learner message.

Features you get
Teacher-defined grounding
Combine objective, authoritative content, support files and tutor behavior.
Hints and final-answer controls
Choose whether and when those assistance modes are available.
Local rate limiting
Apply a per-user/per-conversation limit before requesting an AI response.
Separate-group access
Respect group boundaries when teachers inspect learner conversations.
Backup and restore
Include activity configuration and user conversations when backup settings allow user data.
Privacy API
Export and delete conversation data through Moodle's privacy framework.

Also requires AI Bridge.
